The '''Coruscant police speeder''' was the [[Police speeder|police issued]] [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] for [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
The [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[police speeder]] was utilized by [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] and [[GU-series Guardian police droid/Legends|police droids]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to assist in [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|patrolling]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Coruscant during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was operated by one pilot and could carry three passengers. The back compartment contained bars for prisoner transport. The side of the vehicle would list the jurisdiction as well as the CSF emergency contact number of 9-1-1.

One notable incident was a high speed chase involving [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]], and [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]].

==Behind the scenes==
The police cruiser made their first visual appearance in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars TV series'']] episode ''[[Pursuit of Peace]]''. The cruisers in the episode are shown to belong to [[Coruscant police sector 417/Legends|Police Sector 417]].
